title: Indentation Practice
instructions: In the coding window, indent the `print()` statement using exactly 4 spaces so that the program runs without an error. If you remove the indentation, you should see an `IndentationError`.
steps: Look at the if statement on line 1
Add exactly 4 spaces before the print statement on line 2
Run the code to make sure it works
Try removing the spaces to see the error!
starterCode:
if 1 == 1:
print("I need to be indented!")
solution:
if 1 == 1:
    print("I need to be indented!")
hints: Python requires consistent indentation for code blocks
Use exactly 4 spaces for each level of indentation
The print statement should be indented under the if statement
Don't use tabs - use 4 space characters
